issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: vine, iron_bars, red_wall_banner, moss_carpet, dark_oak_fence, red_banner.
205 blocks, over the module budget of 60 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
13 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.
No door on the front half (z = 0 is the front, toward the easel).
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.roof: Hipped spruce cap on the merlons with a fence and banner finial looks good, but it sits flush with the walls (5x5 at y9) and has no overhang.
notes.life: Vines and torches at the door, hay and a barrel at the base, moss on the platform.
notes.grandeur: The roof and banner make it read as a proper watchtower above the wall.

visual.summary: L2 plus a hipped spruce roof on the merlons with a red banner on a pole, vines, hay, a barrel and moss; clearly the grandest level.
problems: Roof has no overhang: the y9 stair ring covers exactly x0..4 z0..4; widening it to x-1..5 z-1..5 (resting on the y7 corbel line) would read much better.
Same narrow west walk entrance as L1: (0,5,2) and (0,6,2) are solid.
Reachability: fine - unreached are only the roof slopes (y10, y11), two platform corners (3,8,4), (4,8,3) and (1,5,3).

issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: vine, iron_bars, red_wall_banner, moss_carpet, dark_oak_fence, red_banner.
227 blocks, over the module budget of 60 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
13 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.
No door on the front half (z = 0 is the front, toward the easel).

notes.roof: The overhang is fixed: the y9 ring spans x0..6, z0..6, 1 block beyond the walls on every side. But the cone is all plain spruce stairs, with no trim course or different eave colour (e.g. dark oak stairs at the eave ring). It also rests on the merlons only along edges: y9 is air at x1..5, so (1,9,1) and the rest of that ring are empty between the merlon tops (y8) and the y10 ring.
notes.levels: The cone roof, the flag and the vines read at a glance.
notes.life: Vines on the town face, moss carpet on the platform, hay and a barrel by the door.
notes.artefacts: The front-window torch at (3,6,2) has nothing to hang on (floating at L1, on iron bars at L2/L3), so it drops in game. Use a lantern on a block or a wall torch on solid stone.

visual.summary: Level 3: L2 under a spruce cone roof with a 1-block overhang all round, topped by a red banner on a fence pole, with vines, moss, hay and a barrel at the door.
problems: The front-window torch at (3,6,2) has nothing to hang on (floating at L1, on iron bars at L2/L3), so it drops in game. Use a lantern on a block or a wall torch on solid stone.
Wall torch at (3,6,2) facing south hangs on the iron bars at (3,6,1): iron bars have no solid face, so in game the torch drops. Move it beside the window onto (2,6,1) or (4,6,1).

Cone roof: it touches the merlons only along edges, because y9 at x1..5, z1..5 is air (for example (1,9,1) and (3,9,1)). Put a ring of spruce planks or slabs on y9 over the wall line x1..5 so the roof sits on the tower. The pole base, planks at (3,10,3), also has air under it at (3,9,3).
Give the eave ring (y9) a different colour from the rest of the cone (dark oak stairs), so the roof isn't one flat colour.

Joining: the 7 x 7 box puts the tower walls at x1..5 and z1..5, so x0 and x6 are empty from y0 to y8. Placed box to box beside stone_wall_straight v2 (3 deep: parapet z0, 2-wide walk z1-2 with floor at y4), this leaves a 1-block air gap at x0 and x6 with no walk floor, and the tower's walk (z2-3) sits 1 block behind the wall's walk (z1-2). Either fill x0/x6 with the wall profile (floor (0,4,2..3) and (6,4,2..3), parapet at z1), or state the (-1,-1) placement offset in the meta so the layout overlaps the empty ring.
Last round fixed: the overhang is now 1 block all round, and the west walk entrance is 2 wide.
Reachability: fine. The walk room, stair and platform are reached; unreached are only the cone slopes (y10-12) and (2,5,4) beside the stair.

issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: vine, iron_bars, red_wall_banner, moss_carpet, dark_oak_fence, red_banner.
294 blocks, over the module budget of 60 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
13 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.
No door on the front half (z = 0 is the front, toward the easel).

notes.roof: Fixed. A dark oak plank wall plate at y9 (x1..5 ring) sits on the merlons and crenels, and a dark oak stair eave reaches 1 block out all round (x0/x6, z0/z6). The spruce courses at y10 (5x5 ring, dark oak plank deck inside) and y11 (3x3 ring) each rest on solid blocks below. The pole (3,11,3) stands on planks (3,10,3) and carries a red banner at y12. It is 45 degrees and two-tone, so it is no longer one flat colour.
notes.artefacts: The torch fix carried through: (4,6,4) is on (4,6,5). The vines at (2,1,6),(4,1,6),(2,3,6),(4,3,6) attach to the back wall, the hanging lantern (3,6,0) has (3,7,0) above it, and nothing floats.
notes.life: Vines and hay by the door, moss carpet on the platform, lanterns and banners.
notes.levels: The cone roof with its flag changes the silhouette completely, so this is clearly different from L2.

visual.summary: L3 roofs the archer platform with a two-tone cone (dark oak wall plate and eave, spruce courses, banner on a pole) and adds vines, hay, barrels and moss on top of L2's hoarding and banners.
problems: Minor: the wall plate at y9 closes the crenels on top, leaving 1-high slots at y8 such as (4,8,5) and (5,8,4). That is acceptable for a roofed tower, but the archers' openings are now very low.
Minor (carried from L1/L2): the blind barred side windows at (1,2,3)/(5,2,3) face the wall body.
Joining matches stone_wall_straight_l3 v2 block for block. The eave at x0/x6 y9 overhangs the neighbouring wall's walk well above head height (y5-6), so nothing collides. Fixed.

Reachability: fine. The walk, stair, walk room and platform are reached. The places not reached are the cone slopes (y10-12, 48 places), the merlon tops (0,7,1)/(6,7,1), the low crenels (4,8,5)/(5,8,4) and (2,5,4).
